content: Mobile note editors (Notion, Bear, Todoist) share core features: View/Edit toggle, markdown support, autosave, organization (categories/tags), search, and offline-first. Good mobile note editors prioritize speed (launch-to-typing near-instant), minimal friction (fewer taps), beautiful typography, gesture navigation, and offline reliability. For voice-first apps, audio playback in editor is a differentiator not found in standard note apps.
